Layout of the plots

Source: R/helpers.R
sci_layout.Rd

Margins, lines of the patient numbers and of the x-axis title shared by boxplotSCI(), lineplotSCI() and stackedbarplotSCI(), so that plots used together line up. The blueprint is the layout of boxplotSCI().

Usage

sci_layout(n_time, n_groups, risk_table, offset = 0, footnote = FALSE)

Arguments

n_time

Number of time points; 1 for a single time point.

n_groups

Number of groups.

risk_table

Logical. Are patient numbers drawn beneath the x-axis?

offset

Lines taken by extra labels beneath the x-axis (e.g. group labels under bars, or rotated labels), by which the numbers and the x-axis title move down.

footnote

Logical. Is a footnote on the statistic drawn beneath the x-axis title? It adds the same space to every plot type.

Value

A list with mar (for par(mar = )), rows (margin lines of the rows of patient numbers, one per group over time, one for a single time point), xlab_line and note_line (the line of the footnote).
